opening.argument: The concern is the combination of scarcity language and an external financial sign-up route. The speaker urges UK viewers to get in line, predicts a long line, and calls the reopening massive. The description provides an account-opening link, while the video presents XRP as outperforming other major cryptocurrencies that week. A judge should consider whether that combination pressures viewers toward participation before they can assess the offer, even without an explicit guaranteed-return claim.
